raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-15 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. The silver step mixed the two, so v2 evening transactions landed in 00:00-06:00 of the next day (the 2026-01-19 volume drop and the off-hours alerts). The v2 timestamps are shifted to Chicago local time to match legacy. v2 12:00 UTC maps to 06:00 local, where legacy day starts, and all data falls in January (CST, UTC-6).","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
